verdict.rationale: Algolia's official quickstart docs walk a developer through indexing sample data and building a working search UI (React InstantSearch) within minutes, backed by CLI and REST API for creating indices/adding documents, and community comments corroborate the ease of setup and quality of developer experience (e.g., 'very impressed with their developer experience', 'required 0 maintenance'). Missing for 10: independent hands-on timing evidence confirming the 'minutes' claim and no first-party quickstart benchmark/video showing the full flow end-to-end.
